messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

It’s about getting a fair share, not just feeling pressured. B’s share matters too. I haven’t agreed to A buying at a discount, and I won’t subsidize that. I want a fair arrangement for all three, though I don’t want to hurt A. I’d like it settled, but there’s no need to rush.
Yes, that’s right. I haven’t agreed to a discounted purchase, though, and we haven’t decided what a fair share or price would be.
I’d like to buy the house with my husband at a family discount. A good outcome would let us move forward, but I know C needs to agree, and she hasn’t yet.
I suppose what matters most to me is being able to start a dance studio. A good outcome would be a fair way of sorting out the house and will that lets me get the money to do that.
Mostly. A family discount matters to me, and it would need to feel acceptable to C too.
That’s close. I’d say I hope we can reach a fair arrangement that gives me some money to start the studio. I’m not sure yet what a fair share would be.
Yes, that captures it. The price and terms still need to be worked out.

Option 1 could be fair, but market value and everyone’s shares need to be worked out first. I’m not agreeing to Option 2 as described; I’d only consider a discount if I’m genuinely no worse off, and the terms are clear and fair. Nothing’s decided yet.
Option 1 doesn’t include the discount I’m hoping for. Option 2 is closer, but I’d need to understand the terms and know C is comfortable before agreeing.

Option 1 sounds simpler to me, provided the amount and timing of the cash are fair and workable for starting the studio. Option 2 might also be possible, but I’d want to understand the terms before agreeing.
Yes, I’m open to an independent appraisal, and I’d split the cost equally if all three of us agree. It would help establish the value, but it doesn’t decide the shares or terms.
Yes, I’d be open to an independent appraisal and splitting the cost three ways, if B agrees too.
Yes, I’d be open to an independent appraisal and splitting the cost three ways, as long as we all agree on the appraiser and the cost beforehand.
